criteria.criterion: compute_signals returns a mapping with numeric keys: iterations, tasks_done, tasks_total, iterations_per_closed, gate_failures, review_rejections, attempts_burned, no_progress_streak, estimated_spend
criteria.evidence: src/runstat/signals.py:42-52 returns exactly these nine keys

criteria.criterion: No value returned by compute_signals is a string
criteria.evidence: all values are int/float/None (signals.py:42-52); asserted by tests/test_signals.py:20 and the gate

criteria.criterion: iterations_per_closed is None when no task has closed, and a float otherwise
criteria.evidence: signals.py:23 `(iterations / tasks_done) if tasks_done else None`; test_signals.py:58

criteria.criterion: attempts_burned counts records whose outcome is not 'done' — never the sum of the attempts field
criteria.evidence: signals.py:27 `sum(1 for rec in run.iterations if rec["outcome"] != "done")`; matches loop/run.sh sig_attempts()

criteria.criterion: no_progress_streak counts trailing records that did not increase tasks_done, and is 0 for an empty run
criteria.evidence: signals.py:29-38; empty run gives increased_flags=[] so streak stays 0 (test_signals.py:55-59); baseline-of-0-before-first-record logic matches loop/run.sh sig_streak()'s `[0] + $d[:-1]` exactly

criteria.criterion: format_signals returns exactly eight (label, display) pairs in the brief's order
criteria.evidence: signals.py:59-68, list literal with 8 tuples in brief order
verified by gate T4.log and test_signals.py:22-31

criteria.criterion: format_signals renders an undefined ratio as 'n/a' and money with two decimals and a leading $
criteria.evidence: signals.py:57 `"n/a" if per_closed is None`; signals.py:67 `f"${signals['estimated_spend']:.2f}"`; test_signals.py:60

notes: Implementation's no_progress_streak and other formulas match loop/run.sh's existing sig_* shell functions field-for-field (same 0-baseline, same attempts/spend derivations), which is a good early sign for brief 0002 acceptance item 6 (driver and runstat must agree) even though that cross-check isn't formally due until a later task.
